lines.trans: Report, Chen! Which room keys got mixed up during the noon phone call?
Look at my paper ledger: two young hikers booked Room Two on the first floor.

words.gloss: measure word for books and notebooks

lines.trans: Yes, such polite hikers—and a quiet lady carrying a floral hatbox booked Room Six!

words.gloss: to carry by a handle or strap

lines.trans: Now tell Qing where your glasses were sitting when you handed out tags Two and Six.

words.gloss: talk briefly / go ahead and say
measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

lines.trans: Oh dear... upside down two looks like five, no—when everything's blurry, two and six look almost identical!
Don't tell me the hikers hauled their backpacks to Room Six while the hatbox went to Room Two?!

words.gloss: could it be that..., surely not...
to carry by a handle or strap

lines.trans: Lucky break for you, boss—both guests left their bags outside the doors and headed out for lunch!
Really?! Neither guest unlocked the wrong door or unpacked a single shirt yet?!
Two minutes ago I passed right by them at the gate asking where to grab hot lunch soup.
Chen, those sharp eyes of yours are pure gold—can we swap the bags back right now?
And leave a neat welcome note on each door table explaining the right hook number!

words.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

examples.text: 工作上没什么特别的事情发生，就是十二歌王有一件事情我觉得有点不妥。
examples.trans: Nothing unusual happened at work, except there was one detail on Twelve Singers that felt slightly off to me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Locative noun yīlóu ('first floor').

examples.text: 一楼的碎玻璃都已经修过了。
examples.trans: The broken glass on the first floor has already been fixed.

examples.text: 前台接待处就在一楼大厅。
examples.trans: The reception desk is right in the first-floor lobby.

meanings.en: completely identical; cast from the same mold
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì mú yí yàng. Note second-tone mú here ('one mold, one look').

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú duì. Negated adjective 不 ('not', shifting to 2nd-tone bú before 4th-tone duì) + 对 ('right/correct'); often used mid-sentence for a sudden realization ('wait, no!').

examples.text: 左边是糖……不对，もしかしたら右边那罐才是白糖？
examples.trans: The left jar is sugar... wait, no, could the right jar be the sugar?

examples.text: 老陈听了一下琴声说：“不对，这根弦还差一点点。”
examples.trans: Chen listened to the piano and said, 'Hold on, this string is still slightly off.'

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 这是两个啊。
examples.trans: This is two.

examples.text: 那个两个好。
examples.trans: That two is good.

meanings.note: Noun liǎngbiān ('both sides').

examples.text: 他们两边你觉得最后谁能赢？
examples.trans: Between the two camps, who do you think will win?

examples.text: 自从出事以后，两边的关系很紧张。
examples.trans: Relations between both sides have been tense since then.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个中午 ('a noon hour').

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎi. Everyday verb for purchasing goods; contrasts in tone with 卖 (mài 'sell').

examples.text: 看我的！快说要买什么。
examples.trans: Watch me! Tell me quickly what to buy.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Describes either physical disorder or a confused mind.

examples.text: 我现在心里有点乱。
examples.trans: My mind feels a little tangled right now.

examples.text: 办公桌上放得太乱了。
examples.trans: The desk is far too messy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ. Cardinal number 5.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā men. Third-person plural pronoun for male or mixed groups.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Polite counterpart of 个 when counting guests, customers, or teachers (一位客人, 这位老师).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.en: informal written note; brief message slip
meanings.note: Pinyin: biàn tiáo. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张便条 (a short note).

examples.text: 还在每间房门口的小桌上留张工整的欢迎便条，写明正确的挂钩号！
examples.trans: And leave a neat welcome note on each door table explaining the right hook number!

examples.text: 宋老师在门框上夹了一张便条，提醒志豪四点整到九号房练琴。
examples.trans: Song clipped a brief note on the doorframe reminding Hao to practice piano in Room Nine at four sharp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Used for pouring tea, water, or juice into a cup or pot (倒茶 'pour tea').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Introduces a likeness or example ('look like, be like').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 他长得真像他哥哥。
examples.trans: He really looks like his older brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liù. Cardinal number 6.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.en: to write down clearly; to specify explicitly in text
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě míng. Resultative compound combining 写 (write) with 明 (clear) to show no ambiguity remains.

examples.text: 大中午的能有什么变故？人家客人可是用黑墨水白纸黑字写明今晚六点呀！
examples.trans: What could possibly change at noon? Our guest wrote six tonight in black ink on white paper!

examples.text: 欢迎卡片上写明了客人的房号和晚茶开始的时间。
examples.trans: The welcome card clearly stated the guest's room number and the starting time for afternoon tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐ. Asks about small numbers (几点 'what time', 几个 'how many') before a measure word.

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū. Core directional verb meaning 'outward'.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.en: go out the door; head out
meanings.note: Pinyin: chū mén. Separable verb-object compound for leaving home or the inn.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 五分钟 ('five minutes').

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng. Placed right before a verb to show the action happened moments ago.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ fàn. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿午饭 ('a lunch').

examples.text: 午饭以后，两位能帮我们把地下室的桌子搬进来吗？
examples.trans: After lunch, could you two help us carry the cellar tables in?

examples.text: 老陈，午饭以前能修好吗？你有新的保险丝吧？
examples.trans: Chen, can you fix it before lunch? You do have new fuses, right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuāng. Counts naturally paired items: shoes, socks, chopsticks, hands (一双皮鞋 'a pair of leather shoes').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

meanings.en: two-strap backpack worn over both shoulders
meanings.note: Pinyin: shuāng jiān bāo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī). Literally 'twin-shoulder bag.'

examples.text: 难不成徒步客把双肩包拎去六号房，而帽盒去了二号房？！
examples.trans: Don't tell me the hikers hauled their backpacks to Room Six while the hatbox went to Room Two?!

examples.text: 两个绿双肩包也整整齐齐码在二号房旁边的长凳上了。
examples.trans: And both green backpacks are lined up neatly on the bench beside Room Two.

meanings.note: Verb fā ('issue / release / post').

examples.text: 辛惠美发了新歌！
examples.trans: Xin Huimei released a new song!

examples.text: 我给你发了消息。
examples.trans: I sent you a message.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chī. Everyday verb for eating meals, bread, or snacks.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.en: we; us; our (inclusive of both the speaker and the listener)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zánmen. Unlike 我们 (which can exclude the listener), 咱们 specifically includes the person spoken to, creating a warm, collegial, or colloquial tone. Directly modifies nouns without 的 in set expressions like 咱们这行.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yō. Natural spoken exclamation of effort, surprise, or mild pain.

examples.text: 哎哟，这扇旧木窗板卡得真紧呀！
examples.trans: Ugh, this old wooden shutter is stuck so tight!

examples.text: 哎哟，茶杯还很烫，端的时候小心点儿。
examples.trans: Ooh, the teacup is still very hot—be careful carrying it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎ. Combines with a measure word to ask 'which?' (哪个 'which one?', 哪间 'which room?').

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎr. Spoken northern/standard variant of 哪里 ('where').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí lái. Directional compound for returning toward the speaker's place.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

meanings.note: Pinyin: quān. Counts full turns of a key, wrench, or lap around a block (一圈 'one full turn').

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 我绕着广场走了一圈。
examples.trans: I walked one lap around the square.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个外面 ('an outside area').

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 门外站着一位拿箱子的客人。
examples.trans: A guest holding a suitcase is standing outside the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén kǒu. Location noun built from 大门 ('main gate') + 口 ('entranceway').

examples.text: 送货车停在客栈大门口等我们签字。
examples.trans: The delivery van parked at the inn's front gate waiting for us to sign.

examples.text: 大门口的两盆绿植物刚浇过水。
examples.trans: The two pots of green plants by the main gate were just watered.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài. Often frames 太 + adj + 了 for warm exclamations (太好了！ 'Wonderful!').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǚ shì. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位女士 ('a lady').

examples.text: 打扰了，女士……等等，这个声音！教钢琴的宋老师？！
examples.trans: Excuse me, ma'am... wait, that voice! Teacher Song, my piano teacher?!

examples.text: 前台有位姓宋的女士在等您。
examples.trans: A Ms. Song is waiting for you at reception.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位客人 ('a guest').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Means 'correct!' on its own, 'right' as a result complement (拿对), or 'to/toward' before a noun.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

工整.gloss: neat and regular; carefully formed (of handwriting)

meanings.en: neat and regular; carefully formed (of handwriting)
meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng zhěng. Specifically praises tidy, well-proportioned handwriting or layout (字迹工整 'neat handwriting').

examples.text: 这张米色菜谱卡片是用工整的蓝钢笔字写的。
examples.trans: This cream recipe card is written in neat blue fountain-pen handwriting.

examples.text: 宋老师在欢迎卡片上写了两行工整漂亮的毛笔字。
examples.trans: Teacher Song wrote two lines of neat, graceful brushwork on the welcome card.

meanings.en: round or sturdy travel box designed for carrying hats
meanings.note: Pinyin: mào hé. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī). Combines 帽 (hat) with 盒 (box).

examples.text: 对呀，特别礼貌的两位徒步客——还有位拎花纹帽盒的文静女士订了六号房！
examples.trans: Yes, such polite hikers—and a quiet lady carrying a floral hatbox booked Room Six!

examples.text: 小晴把那个圆条纹帽盒轻轻捧到六号房门口的小凳上。
examples.trans: Qing gently carried the round striped hatbox over to the small bench outside Room Six.

meanings.note: In one's youth.

examples.text: 团队里有很多充满活力的年轻编导。
examples.trans: The team has many energetic young writer-directors.

examples.text: 年轻的时候多经历一些挫折其实是好事。
examples.trans: Facing a few setbacks while young is actually a good thing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú bù kè. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi) or 名 (míng). Combines 徒步 (go on foot) with 客 (guest, traveler).

examples.text: 看我这本纸账本：两位年轻徒步客订的是一楼二号房。
examples.trans: Look at my paper ledger: two young hikers booked Room Two on the first floor.

examples.text: 那两位徒步客喝完热汤回来，看到门口的欢迎便条高兴极了。
examples.trans: When the two hikers came back from hot soup, they were delighted by the welcome note outside their door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒng. Indicates what consistently happens or must happen (总得有人 'somebody has to').

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: hit; make (a call); give (a score); fetch
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ. Light verb forming dozens of everyday expressions (打电话 'make a phone call').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Verb káng ('carry someone/something heavy on shoulders').

examples.text: 上次他在路边难受，还是我把他扛回去的。
examples.trans: Last time he got sick outside, I carried him back.

examples.text: 再大的收视压力，总制作人都得扛住。
examples.trans: A chief producer shoulders even the heaviest pressure.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

拎.gloss: to carry by a handle or strap

meanings.en: to lift and carry something dangling from one's hand (bag, basket, hatbox)
meanings.note: Pinyin: līn. Everyday verb contrasting with 抱 (hug in arms), 扛 (hoist on shoulder), and 捧 (cradle in both hands).

examples.text: 对呀，特别礼貌的两位徒步客——还有位拎花纹帽盒的文静女士订了六号房！
examples.trans: Yes, such polite hikers—and a quiet lady carrying a floral hatbox booked Room Six!

examples.text: 难不成徒步客把双肩包拎去六号房，而帽盒去了二号房？！
examples.trans: Don't tell me the hikers hauled their backpacks to Room Six while the hatbox went to Room Two?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná. Core verb for holding or fetching objects in the hand.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà gōu. Combines 挂 ('hang') + 钩 ('hook'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 这块木板在我手里十五年，一直只有一到八号挂钩。
examples.trans: For fifteen years in my hands, this wooden board only ever had hooks one through eight.

examples.text: 老陈把擦亮的九号黄铜挂钩稳稳拧在木板右边。
examples.trans: Chen screwed the polished brass number-nine hook firmly onto the right side of the wooden board.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huàn. Used for swapping suitcases, changing rooms, or replacing broken parts.

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Used for answering calls (接电话), meeting someone at a station, or catching drips.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 志豪接干毛巾的时候随手放下的！
examples.trans: Hao set it down casually when he took the dry towel!

擦肩而过.gloss: to brush past; pass right by

meanings.en: to brush shoulders in passing; pass close by someone
meanings.note: Pinyin: cā jiān ér guò. Vivid four-character idiom used both literally at narrow gates and figuratively for narrow misses.

examples.text: 两分钟前我在大门口刚跟他们擦肩而过，他们正打听上哪儿买午饭热汤呢。
examples.trans: Two minutes ago I passed right by them at the gate asking where to grab hot lunch soup.

examples.text: 小晴抱着帽盒上楼时，正好和下楼拿茶壶的小美在楼梯拐角擦肩而过。
examples.trans: Carrying the hatbox upstairs, Qing brushed right past Mei coming down for a teapot at the landing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.en: soft-spoken; gentle; calm and refined in manner
meanings.note: Pinyin: wén jìng. Warm compliment combining 文 (refined, scholarly) with 静 (quiet, serene).

examples.text: 对呀，特别礼貌的两位徒步客——还有位拎花纹帽盒的文静女士订了六号房！
examples.trans: Yes, such polite hikers—and a quiet lady carrying a floral hatbox booked Room Six!

examples.text: 那位文静的客人夸赞六号房窗外的梧桐树影安静又好看。
examples.trans: That gentle-mannered guest praised how peaceful and lovely the wutong tree shadows looked outside Room Six.

meanings.note: Friendly workplace farewell míngtiān jiàn.

examples.text: 我先走了，明天见！
examples.trans: I am heading off, see you tomorrow!

examples.text: 大家辛苦了，明天见！
examples.trans: Great work everyone, see you tomorrow!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

本.gloss: measure word for books and notebooks

meanings.en: measure word for books and notebooks
meanings.note: Pinyin: běn. Counts bound volumes, notebooks, ledgers, and albums (一本书, 一本账本).

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 书桌上放着两本旧乐谱。
examples.trans: Two old music books sit on the desk.

架.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

meanings.en: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines
meanings.note: Pinyin: jià. Counts pianos, airplanes, and framed instruments (一架钢琴 'a piano').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 客厅角落里放着一架老钢琴。
examples.trans: An old piano stands in the corner of the living room.

examples.text: 桌上的东西你可以看看。
examples.trans: Take a look at the folder I left on your desk.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: out of focus; blurry to the eyes or vague in memory
meanings.note: Pinyin: mó hú. Describes vision without reading glasses as well as faint handwriting or distant outlines.

examples.text: 哎哟……倒过来看，二像五，不对——模糊起来二和六简直一模一样！
examples.trans: Oh dear... upside down two looks like five, no—when everything's blurry, two and six look almost identical!

examples.text: 周经理架上老花镜以后，原来模糊的钥匙牌号一下子清楚极了。
examples.trans: Once Zhou slid his reading glasses on, the blurry numbers on the key tags turned crystal clear.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān yíng. Warm greeting to arriving guests (欢迎！ / 欢迎光临！).

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng què. Praises an exact answer.

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

examples.text: 您填写的电话号码和地址完全正确。
examples.trans: The phone number and address you wrote down are completely correct.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Formally reporting progress or proposals to superiors or partners.

examples.text: 下午我们要去电视台汇报改版方案。
examples.trans: This afternoon we are going to the station to present the revamp plan.

examples.text: 请每周五向总监汇报一次项目进度。
examples.trans: Please report project progress to the director every Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: fiery golden eyes; uncanny sharp-eyed perception
meanings.note: Pinyin: huó yǎn jīn jīng. Alludes to Sun Wukong's demon-spotting eyes in Journey to the West.

examples.text: 老陈，你这双火眼金睛太管用了——咱们能立刻把行李换回来吗？
examples.trans: Chen, those sharp eyes of yours are pure gold—can we swap the bags back right now?

examples.text: 多亏了小晴那双火眼金睛，藏在旧地图角落里的小字一下子就被发现了。
examples.trans: Thanks to Qing's eagle eyes, the tiny writing tucked in the old map's corner was spotted right away.

examples.text: 厨房里炖着一锅鲜美的热汤，满屋子都是香味。
examples.trans: A pot of savory hot soup is simmering in the kitchen, filling the whole house with its aroma.

examples.text: 请趁热喝下这碗热汤，身上的寒气马上就散了。
examples.trans: Please drink this bowl of hot soup while it is hot, and the chill in your bones will vanish right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pái zi. Wooden or chalk signboard at a shop or stall (also means 'brand'). Measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 水果摊的木牌子上用粉笔写着今天的特价。
examples.trans: Today's special prices are written in chalk on the fruit stall's wooden sign.

examples.text: 大门口挂着“营业中”的小木牌子。
examples.trans: A small wooden 'Open' sign hangs at the front entrance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tè bié. Very common intensifier before adjectives/verbs ('especially'), or adjective ('special').

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 都没有！他特别喜欢安静的木房梁，还谢谢我们呢。
examples.trans: Neither! He loved the quiet wooden beams and even thanked us.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn huà. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个电话 ('a phone call').

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: de shí hou. High-frequency temporal frame placed at the end of a verb or clause to mean 'when / while ...' (往下迈的时候 'when stepping down').

examples.text: 小美够最上面那层架子的时候，小晴赶紧上前扶住了木凳。
examples.trans: While Mei was reaching for the top shelf, Qing hurried over to steady the wooden stool.

examples.text: 我擦厨房台面的时候，罐子底下的纸标签不小心被水弄湿了。
examples.trans: When I was wiping the kitchen counter, the paper labels under the jars got damp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn de. Used standalone ('Really?!' 真的吗？！) or before verbs as an emphatic adverb.

examples.text: 真的吗？！你真的把火车票改到星期六早上了？
examples.trans: Really?! Did you really move your train ticket to Saturday morning?

examples.text: 加了杏仁粉的柠檬挞真的特别香！
examples.trans: The lemon tart made with almond flour is truly fragrant!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jìng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副眼镜 ('a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

related.gloss: a pair of glasses (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ mào. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种礼貌 ('good manners').

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 小伙子对每位长辈说话都很有礼貌。
examples.trans: The young man speaks politely to every elder.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì kè. Crisp adverb for immediate action.

examples.text: 你们两位都懂？！放下茶杯——现在立刻跟我进来！
examples.trans: Both of you?! Put down your teacups—come inside with me this instant!

examples.text: 接到电话后，他立刻赶回客栈帮忙。
examples.trans: Right after getting the call, he hurried back to the inn to help.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn zhí. Emphatic adverb expressing enthusiastic amazement (简直无敌了 'simply unbeatable!').

examples.text: 杏仁挞底配上新鲜柠檬，味道简直无敌了！
examples.trans: Almond crust paired with fresh lemon is simply unbeatable!

examples.text: 擦亮玻璃后的阳光房简直像变了一间新屋子。
examples.trans: With the glass polished bright, the sunroom looks practically like a brand-new room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suàn. Means 'calculate' or 'count as'.

examples.text: 明天早上八点，你们的第一杯小院咖啡算客栈请客！
examples.trans: And tomorrow morning at eight, your first courtyard coffees are on the house!

examples.text: 我算了一下，一共十五块钱。
examples.trans: I added it up—fifteen yuan in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎn yòng. Colloquial stative adjective/verb 管 ('govern/take care of') + 用 ('use/function').

examples.text: 垫着枕头歇了两天真管用——今天一点也不疼了！
examples.trans: Resting two days propped on pillows really worked wonders—it doesn't hurt a bit today!

examples.text: 老陈修门窗的小办法简单又管用。
examples.trans: Chen's little tricks for fixing doors and windows are simple and effective.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fān. Used for flipping open a notebook (翻开) or doubling an amount (翻一倍).

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: láo bǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老板 ('a boss / shop owner').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

related.gloss: a boss / shop owner (measure word 位)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo chén. Affectionate respectful name for Courtyard Inn's handyman.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
examples.trans: Thank you, Chen. The little wooden train inside looked very precious.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ér. Connects contrasting or balanced descriptions.

examples.text: 而你们两个孩子把十二号最珍贵的部分留在这儿了。
examples.trans: And you two boys kept the most precious part of Number twelve right here.

examples.text: 院子不大，而处处都很干净。
examples.trans: The courtyard is not big, yet every corner is clean.

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.en: decorative pattern, floral motif, or fine grain
meanings.note: Pinyin: huā wén. Measure word: 道 (dào) or 种 (zhǒng) for a specific pattern.

examples.text: 对呀，特别礼貌的两位徒步客——还有位拎花纹帽盒的文静女士订了六号房！
examples.trans: Yes, such polite hikers—and a quiet lady carrying a floral hatbox booked Room Six!

examples.text: 胡桃木画框边上刻着细细的卷草花纹，手艺非常精巧。
examples.trans: Fine scroll patterns are carved along the walnut frame, showing remarkable craftsmanship.

meanings.note: Suitcases and gear packed for travel.

examples.text: 出发去机场前，他帮大家把行李搬上了车。
examples.trans: Before heading to the airport, he loaded everyone's luggage aboard.

examples.text: 出差几天而已，带一件轻便的随身行李就够了。
examples.trans: For just a few days away, one light carry-on bag is plenty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn shān. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件衬衫 ('a shirt').

examples.text: 看楼上阁楼窗户：志豪已经换了三件衬衫了！
examples.trans: Look up at the attic window: Hao has changed shirts three times already!

examples.text: 他今天穿了一件干净的白衬衫上班。
examples.trans: He wore a crisp white shirt to work today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng. Specifically used for reserving rooms, tickets, or restaurant tables (订房间).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 是谁啊？又有人订周末的房间吗？
examples.trans: Who is it? Someone else booking a room for the weekend?

说说.gloss: talk briefly / go ahead and say

meanings.en: talk briefly / go ahead and say
meanings.note: reduplicated 说 inviting someone to speak casually

examples.text: 跟你开玩笑的，说说。
examples.trans: I was joking with you — go ahead and tell me.

examples.text: 你先说说你的具体想法吧。
examples.trans: Go ahead and tell me your specific thoughts first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàng běn. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本账本 ('an account ledger').

examples.text: 说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
examples.trans: Right you are. Paperwork can wait—set it beside the ledger for now.

examples.text: 每天关门以前，经理都会核对一遍账本。
examples.trans: Before closing up each night, the manager checks the ledger.

meanings.en: to be in luck; get a lucky break
meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu yùn. Often heard in 算你走运 ('lucky for you').

examples.text: 算你走运，老板，两位客人把行李放在门外就出门吃午饭去了！
examples.trans: Lucky break for you, boss—both guests left their bags outside the doors and headed out for lunch!

examples.text: 今天真是走运，风刚停下来，烤盘里的蛋糕也刚好晾温了。
examples.trans: What a stroke of luck today—just as the wind died down, the cakes in the tins cooled to the right warmth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ lái. Marks standing up or beginning/evaluating an action.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò lái. Directional compound moving across toward the speaker.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把钥匙 ('a key').

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cuò. Describes mistakes or serves as a result complement meaning 'wrongly' (拿错 'take the wrong one').

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇门 ('a door').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。
examples.trans: Here is the small silver key to the third-floor attic door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 大门口 ('at the doorway').

examples.text: 等等——那星期一晚上门口台阶……第二个蓝箱子……
examples.trans: Wait—then Monday night on our front step... the second blue suitcase...

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiān. Counts rooms of all kinds: bedrooms, guest rooms, studies, kitchens (一间客房 'a guest room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
examples.trans: That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!

难不成.gloss: could it be that..., surely not...

meanings.en: could it be that..., surely not...
meanings.note: Colloquial rhetorical adverb nánbùchéng ('do you mean to say...?').

examples.text: 难不成咱们私下里去医院找他商量？
examples.trans: Could it be that we should go see him privately in hospital?

examples.text: 这么晚灯还亮着，难不成他们还在机房加班？
examples.trans: Lights are still on this late—could they still be working overtime?
